 Watch: Barcelona star brought close to tears during press conference on NT duty 
 BARCELONA, SPAIN - OCTOBER 31: Raphinha of FC Barcelona celebrates scoring his team’s first goal with teammates during the LaLiga EA Sports 2026/27 match between FC Barcelona and Deportivo Alaves at Spotify Camp Nou on October 31, 2026 in Barcelona, Spain. (Photo by David Ramos/Getty Images) 
 November 13, 2026 
 2 
 Barcelona star Raphinha was involved in an emotional scene during an appearance in front of the media whilst on international duty on Friday.
 Wide-man Raphinha has for his part seen his name dominate the headlines in his home country of Brazil over recent days. This comes after some called into question the 29-year-old’s commitment to the Seleção cause.
 Raphinha suffered an injury setback during the September international break, which derailed his spectacular opening to the club campaign in Barcelona colours.
 Speaking during a recent exchange with the media, the former Leeds United man was therefore keen to make clear to manager Carlo Ancelotti that his minutes will need to be carefully managed this time round.
 Many in Brazil saw this as something of an insult, adamant that their players, when fit, should make themselves available for as many minutes as required.
 And this calling into question of his loyalties to his nation evidently hit Raphinha hard…
 Drawn on the situation during a further press conference on Friday, the explosive attacker was visibly emotional, whilst explaining:
 “I’ve never given up on the national team. I always want to be available. And for Barça too. I only said that I had to take care of myself; I don’t want to get injured again.”
 💔 LA EMOCIÓN DE RAPHINHA
😢 Casi llorando: "Quiero estar disponible para Brasil y para el Barça"
